claim: Can an independent Yggdrasil causal-cell successor detect a contradiction in actual chosen public action outcomes, revise affected three-parent tables and retain unchanged knowledge?
source: Internally authored SOURCE-ONLY two 8-bit worlds, three public actions, world_seed 9101 and 9102, each output bit exactly three potentially different input parents; one world and one action change structurally after baseline FIT; no external environment execution, no protected seeds or source identity, no held scientific first-use.

mechanism.baseline: original unchanged R7 fit from 192 initial FIT source rows per world/action, stored immutably
mechanism.online: per-world/per-action fast/slow trace of selected public outcomes, bounded FIFO length 48; detect contradictions, fit updated same-three-parent hypothesis on recent rows, replace only affected action model, permit return to old model on renewed supporting outcomes
mechanism.forbidden: no privileged change flag, reward oracle, hidden parent indexes, protected role, deep copy of original code with edits, artificial hidden source metadata

comparators: independent conventional incremental three-parent exhaustive refit on same new public observations
independent Bayesian-style error/change-point selecting old versus recent same-class refit
acceptance: initial R7 and independently fit conventional same world/action predictions before change
changed action improves over frozen R7 after actual public new observations
no spurious model revisions on stationary world/actions
preserve unaffected action and world exact predictions
source-model checkpoint survives independent cold Python process and alteration detected
strong conventional results reported with no native novelty claim on a tie
record CPU time and serialized state with no Pareto claim from incomparable costs
source-only tests focused, full existing repo qualification remains separate and fail-closed
